commentary.text: 90+4' Cesar Soto Grado is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' A clever short pass gives Borja Iglesias (Betis) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post.
90+4' Isco (Betis) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90+3' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Betis have a corner.
90+2' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Soto Grado had an easy-decision to make.
87' Chadi Riad (Betis) wins the ball from the corner and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but it's a soft effort and drifts well past the left post.
87' Isco (Betis) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
86' Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
85' Ricardo Visus (Betis) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
82' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
80' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
80' Luiz Henrique (Betis) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Soria intercepts the ball.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) comes onto the pitch for Mason Greenwood.
74' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
72' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Rodri will be replaced by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis).
72' Assane Diao goes off the pitch and Luiz Henrique (Betis) comes on.
71' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the middle of the goal, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Claudio Bravo. What a save!
70' The corner kick from Mason Greenwood (Getafe) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

70' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Getafe will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
69' Hector Bellerin (Betis) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
68' Juan Miranda (Betis) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
64' Carles Alena (Getafe) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
64' Here is a change. Stefan Mitrovic is going off and Jose Bordalas Jimenez gives the last tactical orders to Carles Alena (Getafe).
64' Jaime Mata comes off the pitch to be replaced by Juanmi Latasa (Getafe).
63' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle as Assane Diao (Betis) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
60' The game has come to an end for German Pezzella. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of William Carvalho (Betis).
60' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. Ricardo Visus (Betis) replaces Andres Guardado.
59' Isco (Betis) has a huge chance to score from close range, but his effort goes just a few inches wide of the right-hand post.
59' Andres Guardado (Betis) takes a short corner kick.
58' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
57' Assane Diao (Betis) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
55' Here's the change. Damian Suarez leaves the pitch and Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) comes on as a substitute.
53' Isco (Betis) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

52' Isco (Betis) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. Betis will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
51' Isco (Betis) tries to find Borja Iglesias, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
50' A cross from a corner kick by Betis is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

50' Andres Guardado (Betis) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The referee blows his whistle, Betis are awarded a corner kick.
48' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) misses a sitter as his shot goes over the bar.
47' Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Jose Bordalas Jimenez gives a chance to Omar Alderete (Getafe) and Mauro Arambarri is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' Direct free kick. Mason Greenwood (Getafe) attempts to beat the opposition's defence with a fine lofted pass into the penalty box, but one of the defenders reacts well and averts the threat.
45+3' Jose Bordalas Jimenez (Getafe) gets a yellow card, off the field.
45+1' Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
43' Betis take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
43' What was Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by German Pezzella (Betis) was quite harsh and Cesar Soto Grado didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
38' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) takes the corner kick, but Claudio Bravo reads it well and stops the effort.
38' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
38' Diego Rico (Getafe) has tested the patience of referee Cesar Soto Grado and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
34' Andres Guardado (Betis) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
33' The resulting corner from Mason Greenwood (Getafe) comes to nothing.
33' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
31' Borja Iglesias (Betis) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
30' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle. Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) commits a foul after dangerous play. It's a free kick to Betis in a dangerous position.
26' Isco (Betis) zig-zags his way into the box and fires the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
25' The ball is cleared after Assane Diao (Betis) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
22' Betis have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
22' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.
21' Isco (Betis) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
20' Assane Diao (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
17' 1 - 1 Borja Mayoral (Getafe) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header into the top right corner. Excellent finish.
16' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
14' Assane Diao (Betis) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
13' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Cesar Soto Grado saw the whole situation.
12' Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) wasted a golden chance to score after he found some space inside the box and unluckily volleyed the ball narrowly over the bar.
12' Jaime Mata (Getafe) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
11' Jaime Mata (Getafe) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
8' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Claudio Bravo comes off the line to clear the ball away.
7' A pass from Assane Diao (Betis) is intercepted by David Soria and the move breaks down.
4' It looks like German Pezzella (Betis) saw red with that tackle. Cesar Soto Grado won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
1' 0 - 1 Marc Roca (Betis) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball inside the left post.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Betis will kick the game off.
Cesar Soto Grado got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
